lines: Arr: sixteen knobs sent out as one polyphonic cable, with a choice of quantizing each knob to a scale, an octave or a fraction
Sets the voltage of that channel, within the range chosen on the menu and snapped to the grid chosen there

Menu — Voltage Range — sets the range every knob covers: 0V-10V, 0V-5V, 0V-3V, 0V-1V, +/-10V, +/-5V, +/-3V or +/-1V
Menu — Snap to — chooses what the knobs snap to: None, Octave (1V), Steps, a scale, or a fraction
Menu — Root note — sets the root the chosen scale is built on
Menu — Add Expander — places a ReX, InX or OutX expander on the correct side of this module
Note — values arriving from an input expander are snapped the same way the knobs are
